component.name: TS3 Identity Level
component.summary: Raise the security level of a TeamSpeak 3 identity on a GPU

description.p: TS3 Identity Level is a small Linux utility that increases the "security level" of a TeamSpeak 3 identity file by running the underlying SHA-1 proof-of-work on a CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU. Pick your `.ini`, pick a target level (or run forever), and the tool updates the file in place each time it finds a higher level.

Initial release. CLI and GTK4/libadwaita GUI. CUDA backend.
